cat >> analysis/render-queue-recovery-2026-10-28/architecture.md <<'MD'

A live host-launch check exposed a library-specific locking collision: `proper-lockfile` indexes ownership by target path, even when `lockfilePath` differs. The host lease now uses a separate target (`render-queue/worker-host`), so startup/reuse cannot overwrite or release the canonical queue transaction's lock. The regression test acquires a real canonical lock while the spawned host is starting and verifies that it remains independently releasable. This was not observable in the isolated renderer-only fixture, so final live host launch is also required before completion.
MD
